The series includes six model sizes (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, and 32B) to meet diverse developer needs. Trained on a massive volume of code data, Qwen2.5-Coder excels in code-centric applications while maintaining strong mathematical and reasoning abilities ...
